title: Linvoseltamab Versus Daratumumab, Bortezomib, Cyclophosphamide, and Dexamethasone (Dara-Vcd) in Adult Participants With Newly Diagnosed Systemic Light Chain Amyloidosis
off: An Open-Label, Randomized Phase 3 Trial of Linvoseltamab Compared With Daratumumab, Bortezomib, Cyclophosphamide, and Dexamethasone (Dara-Vcd) in Participants With Newly Diagnosed Systemic Light Chain Amyloidosis
summary:
This study is researching a Regeneron drug called linvoseltamab ("study drug") alone compared to standard of care (SoC) combination to see if it can help treat participants who are newly diagnosed and previously untreated for systemic amyloid light-chain (AL) amyloidosis.

The aim of this study is to see if the safety and efficacy of linvoseltamab alone can deliver better disease control and outcomes than Dara-VCd.

The study is looking at:

* What side effects linvoseltamab alone might cause
* How well linvoseltamab works compared to Dara-VCd regimen in terms of reductions of the abnormal proteins that cause AL-amyloidosis that affects the heart and kidney functions and for how long
* How much linvoseltamab is in the blood at different times
* Whether the body makes antibodies against linvoseltamab (which could make the drug less effective or could lead to side effects)
elig:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

1. Confirmed diagnosis of AL amyloidosis as documented historically, as described in the protocol
2. Measurable disease as defined by serum difference between involved and uninvolved free light chains (dFLC), as described in the protocol
3. Adequate hematologic, renal, and hepatic function, as described in the protocol
4. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance score ≤2 at screening

Key Exclusion Criteria:

1. History of other non-AL amyloidosis
2. Greater than or equal to 60% plasmacytosis on a bone marrow biopsy and/or aspirate during screening
3. Presence of lytic bone lesion(s) or plasmacytoma (extramedullary or paraskeletal) on imaging during screening
4. Left ventricular ejection fraction \<40% by echocardiogram during screening, congestive heart failure and acute coronary syndrome or myocardial infarction within 6 months of screening
5. Prior AL amyloidosis treatment

Note: Other protocol-defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria apply

primary.m: Occurrence of Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI)
Achievement of Hematologic Complete Response (HemCR) per International Society of Amyloidosis (ISA) response criteria as determined by Blinded Independent Review Committee (BIRC)
